BETA Close X Ninety One plc has announced the repurchase of 152,936 ordinary shares between June 3rd and June 5th, 2026, for a total cost of £327,199.62. These repurchases are part of the company's ongoing share buyback program, and the acquired shares are intended for cancellation. Following these transactions, Ninety One plc holds no shares in treasury, and its total number of ordinary shares in issue is now 668,519,464. Morgan Securities plc by the Company on 3 June 2026 as announced on 3 June 2026. The Company intends to cancel the purchased shares. Since 3 June 2026, the Company has purchased 152,936 shares at a cost of £327,199.62. Following the above transaction, the Company holds none of its ordinary shares in treasury and has 668,519,464 ordinary shares in issue. This figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine whether they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules of the Financial Conduct Authority. This announcement does not constitute, or form part of, an offer or any solicitation of an offer for securities in any jurisdiction.
